name: Sukagawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sukagawa city emblem in blue: a stylised fan-shaped device with a ring at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Sukagawa, a city in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 22 December 1989; the emblem dates from 10 June 1954.

features.role: Sukagawa city emblem — a stylised fan-shaped device with a ring at the bottom
